blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visual document understanding is essential for acquiring knowledge from visually rich documents and is attracting growing research interest. Existing surveys emphasize architectures or technical approaches, with limited attention to how task bottlenecks shape technical choices and research priorities. We present a task-centric survey that decomposes long-document visual question answering (VQA) into four components: document parsing, evidence organization and retrieval, generator organization and learning, and evaluation. For each, we develop a fine-grained taxonomy and trace motivations, technical responses, and cross-component connections. We focus on explicit retrieval while covering direct reading. Our temporal analysis traces expanding priorities from multimodal content understanding to sufficient, high-fidelity evidence acquisition and sustained evidence management. We outline future directions in evidence sufficiency, verifiable and correctable understanding, and budget-aware coordination, with an outlook on continual document understanding.
blocks.zh: 视觉文件理解对从视觉丰富的文件中获取知识至关重要,并正在吸引越来越多的研究兴趣。 现有的调查强调结构或技术方法,对任务瓶颈如何决定技术选择和研究优先事项的关注有限。 我们提出了一个以任务为中心的调查,将长文件的视觉问题回答(VQA)分为四个部分:文件解析、证据组织和检索、生成器组织和学习以及评价。 对于每一个,我们发展出精细的分类学和微量的动机,技术反应,以及交叉组件连接. 我们的重点是明确检索,同时涵盖直接阅读。 我们的时间分析可追溯到从了解多式联运内容到充分、高可靠性证据的获取和持续的证据管理等优先事项的扩大。 我们概述了证据充足性、可核查和可更正的理解以及预算意识协调方面的未来方向,并展望持续的文件理解。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Visually rich documents, such as research papers and financial reports, play a vital role in preserving and communicating knowledge through text, tables, charts, images, and their spatial and cross-modal relationships.
Visual document understanding (VDU) interprets this content and structure, encompassing foundational tasks such as information extraction, as well as higher-level visual question answering (VQA) ( Chen et al., 2024 ) .
While information extraction identifies target fields, entities, and relations, document VQA selects and integrates evidence to answer questions ( Mathew et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh:
研究论文和财务报告等视觉丰富的文件在通过文本、表格、图表、图像及其空间和跨模式关系保存和交流知识方面发挥着至关重要的作用。
视觉文档理解(VDU)解释这种内容和结构,包括信息提取等基础任务,以及更高层次的视觉问答(VQA)(Chen等,2024.
虽然信息提取确定了目标字段,实体,和关系,但文档VQA选择并整合了证据来回答问题(Mathew等,2021).

blocks.en:
Document VQA has expanded from single-page understanding ( Mathew et al., 2021 ) to evidence localization in MP-DocVQA ( Tito et al., 2023 ) , cross-page integration in SlideVQA ( Tanaka et al., 2023 ) , and long-context multimodal understanding in MMLongBench-Doc ( Ma et al., 2024b ) .
Longer documents and larger collections increase the computational costs and context demands of exhaustive reading, while textualization or visual compression may discard essential chart, layout, and fine-grained textual information ( Faysse et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) .
Evidence dispersed across pages, sections, or documents requires recovering relationships and integrating complementary information ( Tanaka et al., 2023 ; Cho et al., 2025 ) .
We focus on long-document VQA: how systems can acquire, understand, and verify sufficient evidence to answer questions within a limited budget (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
VQA文件从单页理解(Mathew等,2021年)扩展为在MP-DocVQA(Tito等,2023年)中证明本地化,在SlidVQA(Tanaka等,2023年)中实现跨页整合,在MMLLong Bench-Doc(Ma等,2024年b)中实现长文本多模式理解.
较长的文件和更大的收藏增加了详尽阅读的计算成本和上下文要求,而文字化或视觉压缩可能会丢弃基本图表、布局和精细的文字信息(Faysse等,2025;Yu等,2025)。
分散在各页、章节或文件中的证据需要恢复关系并综合补充信息(Tanaka等,2023;Cho等,2025)。
我们侧重于长文件VQA:系统如何获得、理解和核实充分的证据,以便在有限的预算范围内回答问题(图1)。

blocks.en:
Advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and demand for complex document understanding are accelerating document VQA research.
Methods have expanded from multipage representations to visual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and feedback-driven evidence acquisition and reasoning ( Tito et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026d ) .
Rapid literature growth since 2024 (Fig. 1 ) motivates a systematic review of methods, benchmarks, and technical evolution.
Existing surveys cover document representations and multipage processing ( Barboule et al., 2025 ) , MLLM representations and training ( Ding et al., 2026 ) , multimodal retrieval ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , and visual retrievers and deployment ( Yan et al., 2026c ) .
These surveys primarily organize the literature by model architecture and technical approach.
However, connections among long-document bottlenecks, fine-grained technical analysis, and evolving research motivations remain underexplored.
blocks.zh:
多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的进步和对复杂文件理解的需求正在加速对文件VQA的研究.
方法已经从多页表述扩大到可视取回增强生成(RAG)和由反馈驱动的证据获取和推理(Tito等,2023;Yu等,2025;Wang等,2026d.).
2024年以来的文献快速增长(图一)激发了对方法,基准和技术演变的系统审查.
现有调查涉及文件陈述和多页处理(Barboule等,2025年),MLLM陈述和培训(Ding等,2026年),多模式检索(Gao等,2026年),以及视觉检索和部署(Yan等,2026年c.).
这些调查主要通过示范建筑和技术方法整理文献。
然而,文件篇幅较长的瓶颈、精细的技术分析和不断演变的研究动机之间的联系仍然没有得到充分利用。

blocks.en:
We analyze over 150 papers and organize this survey around task decomposition, fine-grained analysis, and temporal evolution.
Our contributions are threefold: (1) A unified, task-driven framework. We map requirements for content fidelity, sufficient evidence acquisition, evidence use, and reliable evaluation onto four interconnected components: document parsing, evidence organization and retrieval, generator organization and learning, and evaluation. (2) A fine-grained technical taxonomy by task function. We categorize representation and structure, retrieval modalities and granularities, evidence acquisition strategies, reasoning organization and learning objectives, and evaluation capabilities. (3) Technical evolution and future research directions. We trace how task bottlenecks shape technical choices as research priorities expand from multimodal understanding to evidence acquisition and sustained management.
We identify challenges and future directions in evidence sufficiency, verifiable and correctable understanding, and budget-aware coordination, with an outlook on continual document understanding.
blocks.zh:
我们分析150多篇论文,围绕任务分解、精细分析以及时间演变组织这次调查。
我们的贡献有三个方面: (1) 一个由任务驱动的统一框架。 我们将关于内容忠实、充分取证、证据使用和可靠评价的要求绘制成四个相互关联的组成部分:文件解析、证据组织和检索、生成器组织和学习以及评价。 (2)按任务功能分类的精细技术分类. 我们对代表性和结构、检索方式和颗粒性、证据获取战略、推理组织和学习目标以及评价能力进行了分类。 (3)技术演变与未来研究方向. 我们追踪任务瓶颈如何决定技术选择,因为研究优先事项从多模式理解扩大到证据获取和可持续管理。
我们查明在证据充足、可核查和可更正的理解以及预算意识协调方面的挑战和未来方向,并展望持续的文件理解。

blocks.en: Long documents pose three challenges. (i) Input and search scale: more candidate pages expand search spaces and increase context and computational demands for exhaustive reading. (ii) Visual content complexity: information in small text, charts, and spatial layouts may be lost through resizing, conversion to text, or compression. (iii) Evidence distribution and dependencies: answers may require complementary evidence across pages or documents; local relevance does not ensure sufficiency ( Ma et al., 2024b ; Yu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 冗长的文件提出了三个挑战。 (一) 输入和搜索尺度:更多的候选网页扩大搜索空间并增加对详尽阅读的上下文和计算要求。 (二)可视内容复杂度:小文本,图表,和空间布局中的信息可能通过再大小,转换为文本,或压缩而丢失. (三) 证据的分布和依赖性:答案可能需要跨页或跨文件的补充证据;地方相关性不能确保充分性(Ma等,2024b;Yu等,2025.)。

blocks.en:
Four analytical components. Four interconnected components address these challenges. (1) Document parsing addresses visual information loss by preserving details and structure.
Content extraction, visual preservation, and semantic structure construction provide readable representations and navigable structures, balancing fidelity against processing cost. (2) Evidence organization and retrieval addresses search scale and dispersion by acquiring sufficient evidence amid noise.
It locates and selects evidence using document representations and structures, passing it and its sources to the generator. (3) Generator organization and learning addresses evidence dependencies and context limits through evidence integration and verification.
It covers evidence presentation, organizational forms, reasoning processes, and learning objectives under computational constraints; intermediate judgments can guide acquisition, rereading, or verification. (4) Evaluation goes beyond answer scores to assess correctness, grounding, efficiency, and reliability throughout the process.
Checks of evidence acquisition and use or controlled experiments diagnose parsing, retrieval, and reasoning errors and compare techniques’ benefits and costs.
blocks.zh:
四个分析成分. 四个相互关联的组成部分应对这些挑战。 (1) 文件解析通过保存细节和结构处理视觉信息损失。
内容提取,视觉保存,和语义结构构造提供可读的表示和可通航的结构,平衡忠诚与处理成本. (2) 证据的组织和检索涉及在噪音中获取充分证据的搜索规模和散布。
它使用文件说明和结构查找和选择证据,并将其及其来源传递给生成者。 (3) 发电机的组织和学习通过证据整合和核实解决证据依赖性和背景限制问题。
它涵盖证据的提交、组织形式、推理过程以及计算限制下的学习目标;中间判决可以指导获取、再读或核查。 (4) 评价超越了回答分数,以评估整个过程的正确性、地基、效率和可靠性。
检查证据的获取和使用或控制的实验,分析分析、检索和推理错误,比较技术的效益和成本。

blocks.en:
Two technical routes. Fig. 2 connects these components through direct reading and explicit retrieval .
Direct reading answers from given document representations and may use hierarchical encoding, cross-page fusion, or compression to manage long-input costs ( Tito et al., 2023 ) .
Explicit retrieval selects question-relevant documents, pages, or elements (e.g., text blocks, tables, and region crops) for the generator to read ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Cho et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2026b ) .
Reasoning feedback can guide further evidence acquisition ( Wang et al., 2026d ) , local rereading, or on-demand parsing of existing evidence.
These components describe task functions; their implementation and execution order may vary.
Explicit retrieval accounts for approximately 80% of surveyed methods, motivating our focus on this route while also covering direct reading.
Sec. 3 develops a fine-grained taxonomy by task function and traces each component’s research motivations and technical evolution.
blocks.zh:
两条技术路线. 图2通过直接读取和明确取回将这些组件连接起来。
直接从给定的文档表达式读取答案,并可能使用分级编码,跨页聚变,或压缩来管理长期输入成本(Tito等,2023.).
明确检索选择与问题有关的文件、页面或要素(例如:文本块、表格和区域作物)供生成者阅读(Yu等,2025;Cho等,2025;Dong等,2026b.)。
理性反馈可以指导进一步取证(Wang等,2026d.),本地重读,或按需分析现有证据.
这些组成部分描述了任务职能;其执行和执行顺序可能有所不同。
明确检索约占所调查方法的80%,促使我们注重这一途径,同时也包括直接阅读。
第3条根据任务功能发展出一种精细的分类,并追踪每个组成部分的研究动机和技术演变。

blocks.en: 3.1 Document Parsing
blocks.zh: 3.1 文档分析

blocks.en: Figure 3: Four stages of document parsing: bottlenecks in black, technical responses in teal.
blocks.zh: 图3:文件解析的四个阶段:黑色的瓶颈,teal的技术反应.

blocks.en:
Technical taxonomy. Document parsing converts raw pages into accessible content and structure.
Tables 1 and 2 distinguish two independent dimensions: OCR and Deep Parsing .
OCR ( ✓ ) denotes dependence on external extraction or textualization, including OCR, PDF text extraction, and VLM transcription or description of charts and tables.
Extracted text supports indexing and language processing, but linearization may lose layout, text–image correspondences, and table structure, while recognition errors can propagate downstream ( Ma et al., 2024a ; Faysse et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) .
OCR ( ✗ ) methods primarily encode pages visually to reduce textualization loss but remain limited by resolution and visual reading ability ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) .
Methods combining extracted or transcribed text with page images are marked OCR ( ✓ ) ( Suri et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2025 ) .
Deep Parsing ( ✓ ) builds semantic overviews or explicit relations: Summary captures page or document semantics, Tree represents section hierarchies and containment, and Graph organizes text–image, entity, or cross-page relations ( Jain et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Yun et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025a ) ; these structures can be combined.
Element transcription or description alone does not count as Deep Parsing.
Parsing may cover full documents in advance or proceed on demand, guided by the question or ongoing process.
blocks.zh:
技术分类学. 文档解析将原始页面转换为可访问的内容和结构。
表1和表2区分出两个独立的维度:OCR和深析.
OCR (✓) 表示对外部取出或文本化的依赖,包括OCR,PDF文本取出,以及VLM转录或图表和表格的描述.
被提取的文本支持索引和语言处理,但线性化可能失去布局,文本-图像对应,和表格结构,而识别错误可以传播到下游(Ma等,2024a; Faysse等,2025;Yu等,2025;Chen等,2024.).
OCR(QQ)方法主要为可视化码页,以减少文本化损失,但仍受分辨率和可视化阅读能力的限制(Yu等,2025;Chen等,2024.).
将取出或转出的案文与页面图像相结合的方法标出OCR ( ) (Suri等,2025;Han等,2025.).
深度解析( ) 构建语义概览或明确的关系 : 摘要抓取页或文档语义,树代表部分分级和封存,图组织文本-图像、实体或跨页关系(Jain等,2025;Wu等,2025b; Yun等,2025; Sun等,2025a;这些结构可以合并.
单凭内容抄录或描述,并不算作"深析".
在问题或现行程序的指导下,分析可事先或按要求处理全部文件。

blocks.en:
Evolution of research focus (Fig. 3 ). Early work prioritized readable content while preserving layout and visual relations.
LayoutLMv3 and UDOP jointly model OCR text, layout, and images ( Huang et al., 2022 ; Tang et al., 2023 ) , while Donut, Pix2Struct, and UReader learn directly from pages or screenshots ( Kim et al., 2022 ; Lee et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2023 ) .
From 2024, explicit retrieval emphasized original-page visual fidelity : DSE, ColPali, VisRAG, and SV-RAG use page images directly ( Ma et al., 2024a ; Faysse et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , while VisDoMRAG and MDocAgent combine visual and textual paths to mitigate omissions and reading biases ( Suri et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2025 ) .
In 2025, navigable structure made content relations accessible: SimpleDoc and Doc-Researcher summarize pages and documents, respectively ( Jain et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2026b ) ; DocAgent builds section hierarchies ( Sun et al., 2025a ) ; and MoLoRAG and LILaC construct page-similarity and layered component graphs, respectively ( Wu et al., 2025b ; Yun et al., 2025 ) .
To avoid parsing irrelevant content at scale, work in 2026 explores parsing on demand : AgenticOCR performs question-guided regional OCR ( Wang et al., 2026f ) ; DocLens, HierDoc, and DocTrace extract elements or parse selected pages ( Zhu et al., 2026a ; Gu et al., 2026 ; Xiang et al., 2026a ) ; and DocClaw adapts parsing tool use to tasks and intermediate results ( Xiang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh:
研究重点的演变(图3). 早期的工作在保留布局和视觉关系的同时,优先安排可读内容.
BloodLMv3和UDOP联合模型OCR文本,布局和图像(黄克等,2022;唐克等,2023;而多努特,Pix2Struct,和UReader直接从页面或截图中学习(金克等,2022;李克等,2023;叶克等,2023.).
从2024年起,明确检索强调原始页面的视觉忠诚度:DSE、ColPali、VisRAG和SV-RAG直接使用页面图像(Ma等人,2024a; Faysse等,2025年;Yu等,2025年;Chen等,2024年;而VisDoMRAG和MdocAgent结合了视觉和文字路径,以减少疏漏和阅读偏差(Suri等,2025年;Han等,2025年)。
2025年,可导航结构使内容关系变得无障碍:SimpleDoc和Doc-Researcher分别总结了网页和文件(Jain等人,2025年;Dong等人,2026年b;DocAgent建立区段分级(Sun等人,2025年a;MoLORAG和LILaC分别构建了同页和分层组件图(Wu等人,2025年b;Yun等人,2025年b)。
为避免在规模上解析无关内容,2026年的工作探索了按要求解析:AgenticOCR执行有问题指导的区域OCR(Wang等,2026f;DocLens,HierDoc;DocTrace提取元素或解析所选页面(Zhu等,2026a; Gu等, 2026; Xiang等, 2026a;和 DocClaw 将解析工具的使用适应任务和中间结果(Xiang等, 2026b).

blocks.en: Parsing supports evidence acquisition (Sec. 3.2 ); its value should be assessed by evidence completeness, answer quality, and cost, rather than transcription accuracy or structural richness alone.
blocks.zh: 分析支持证据的获取(第3.2条);其价值应当通过证据的完整性、答复质量和成本来评估,而不是仅通过抄录准确性或结构丰富性来评估。

blocks.en: 3.2 Evidence Organization and Retrieval
blocks.zh: 3.2 证据组织和检索

blocks.en:
Technical taxonomy. Evidence organization and retrieval select and assemble evidence from parsed content and structures, but local relevance does not ensure sufficient support for cross-page reasoning ( Cho et al., 2025 ) .
Table 1 compares four dimensions. Modality specifies evidence-side matching representations: Uni(T) for text, Uni(V) for vision, and Mixed(T/V) for both. Granularity denotes evidence units supplied to generators or returned by retrieval-only methods: Document covers document-level evidence; Page covers full-page images or complete parsed page content; Element covers independently accessible text blocks, sections, charts, tables, or region crops.
Pages preserve context but may add noise, whereas elements emphasize details but risk losing context.
Modality or granularity may change before generation, as when ViDoRAG maps text chunks to source page images ( Wang et al., 2025 ) ; Table 6 details these mappings. blocks.en:
Evolution of research focus (Fig. 4 ). Hi-VT5 and M3D jointly learn QA and evidence-page prediction over given multipage inputs ( Tanaka et al., 2023 ; Tito et al., 2023 ) , providing a precursor to explicit retrieval.
In 2024, input capacity limits motivated visual page indexing and the rise of explicit retrieval.
DSE uses single-vector screenshot embeddings ( Ma et al., 2024a ) ; ColPali uses multivector late interaction ( Faysse et al., 2025 ) ; and VisRAG, SV-RAG, and M3DocRAG connect page retrieval to visual QA ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Cho et al., 2025 ) .
In 2025, incomplete coverage of linked evidence and local details motivated structural relations, fine-grained acquisition, and feedback-driven iterative retrieval .
MoLoRAG and LILaC link complementary evidence through page or component relations ( Wu et al., 2025b ; Yun et al., 2025 ) ; RegionRAG and Doc-Researcher support regional and multigranular acquisition, respectively ( Li et al., 2026e ; Dong et al., 2026b ) ; and VRAG-RL updates queries, retrieves additional pages, and refines acquired image regions during reasoning ( Wang et al., 2026d ) .
In 2026, attention expands to context, explicit evidence states, and budget constraints .
Doc-V* uses document-wide thumbnails for page navigation ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , while CMDR-Embed incorporates multipage context into page representations ( Tanaka et al., 2026 ) .
MAGE-RAG tracks page and element states ( Zuo et al., 2026 ) ; DocAtlas updates retrieval structures with reading-derived evidence ( Wei et al., 2026b ) ; and DocMemo updates page beliefs and question memory to guide search, reading, and stopping ( Yao et al., 2026b ) .
MAB-DQA allocates retrieval budgets by estimating each subquestion’s acquisition value from VLM feedback ( Xiang et al., 2026c ) .

blocks.en: 3.3 Generation and Learning
blocks.zh: 3.3 培养和学习

blocks.en:
Technical taxonomy. Generation and learning produce grounded answers under context and computational budgets.
Reading all pages preserves context at increasing input cost, whereas reading retrieved evidence narrows inputs but must address evidence gaps and noise.
Tables 1 and 2 compare explicit-retrieval and direct-reading methods. Agent distinguishes Single and Multi by runtime reasoning roles and collaboration. Reasoning distinguishes fixed workflows from feedback loops: Single-pass covers a single chain of thought, structured decoding, or a fixed multi-agent pipeline; Multi-step revises judgments and actions through repeated feedback from intermediate results, tool observations, or verification.
Multi-step may acquire new evidence through feedback (Iterative acquisition) or only reread and verify existing evidence, as in ViDoRAG’s One-shot acquisition ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Learning records added generator-side training: Pretraining develops document representations and cross-modal alignment; SFT uses answer, evidence, or action demonstrations; RL optimizes policies through answer, evidence, or process rewards.
blocks.zh:
技术分类学. 一代和学习在背景和计算预算下产生有根据的答案。

Evolution of research focus (Fig. 5 ). In 2021–2023, pretraining and task fine-tuning established document understanding and grounded answering ( Tanaka et al., 2023 ; Tito et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2022 ; Lee et al., 2023 ) .
In 2024, growing page and token counts motivated long-input handling : GRAM uses document tokens for cross-page communication ( Blau et al., 2024 ) , while mPLUG-DocOwl2 compresses high-resolution visual features ( Hu et al., 2025 ) .
VisRAG and SV-RAG read retrieved pages ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , while Retrieval-aware Tuning fine-tunes generators with evidence and distractor pages ( Chia et al., 2025 ) .
In 2025, single-pass omissions and misreadings motivated evidence-guided learning, feedback reasoning, and tool actions .
ViDoRAG uses cross-role feedback to reread existing candidates ( Wang et al., 2025 ) ; DocR1 improves localization and answering with evidence-page rewards ( Xiong et al., 2026b ) ; and VRAG-RL uses SFT and RL to train VLMs to alternate among search, regional inspection, and answering ( Wang et al., 2026d ) .

DocMemo provides evidence and question memory ( Yao et al., 2026b ) ; AWM rewards memory maintenance for answering ( Zhou et al., 2026a ) ; and SCORE retains provenance, reloads source pages, and reorganizes context before answering ( Shen et al., 2026c ) .

blocks.en:
Evolution of research focus (Fig. 6 ). In 2020–2022, DocVQA, InfographicVQA, and ChartQA benchmarked text, layout, and chart understanding ( Mathew et al., 2021 ; Mathew et al., 2022 ; Masry et al., 2022 ) .
In 2023–2024, longer inputs shifted evaluation toward page identification and cross-page integration ( Tanaka et al., 2023 ; Tito et al., 2023 ) .
DUDE adds complex and unanswerable questions ( Van Landeghem et al., 2023 ) , while MMLongBench-Doc and M-LongDoc assess long-document multimodal understanding ( Ma et al., 2024b ; Chia et al., 2025 ) .
From late 2024 through 2025, RAG prompted evidence and provenance checks beyond answer scores: VISA grounds answers in source-page regions ( Ma et al., 2025a ) , while MMDocIR evaluates page- and element-level retrieval ( Dong et al., 2025 ) .
Work in 2026 targets joint evaluation and capability diagnosis in complex settings .
ViDoRe V3 links retrieval and QA on a shared corpus, with annotated relevant pages as a control ( Loison et al., 2026 ) ; DocScope diagnoses bottlenecks through page, region, fact, and answer scores under varying evidence conditions ( Feng et al., 2026 ) .
CMDR-Bench requires cross-page context for retrieval ( Tanaka et al., 2026 ) ; DVisRAG evaluates retrieval, generation, and end-to-end robustness under visual degradation ( Chen et al., 2026a ) ; and SynthDocBench uses controlled synthesis and structured evidence metadata to diagnose capabilities across document conditions and question types ( Verma et al., 2026 ) .
Across stages, tasks expand to longer documents, cross-page and multi-element evidence, multihop reasoning, and diverse applications.

blocks.en: 4 Research Trends and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 4. 研究趋势和未来方向

blocks.en: Building on component analyses, we examine how their interactions shape priorities and outline challenges and future directions at two levels: improving individual-question answering and extending the task toward continual document understanding.
blocks.zh: 在组成部分分析的基础上,我们审查它们的互动如何在两个层面确定优先事项并概述挑战和今后的方向:改进对个别问题的回答,将任务扩大到持续理解文件。

blocks.en: 4.1 Cross Component Evolution
blocks.zh: 4.1 交叉组件演变

blocks.en:
Document VQA research has broadened from content understanding to evidence acquisition and sustained evidence management (Fig. 7 ).
In 2020–2023, multipage representations and cross-page fusion extended single-page understanding ( Tanaka et al., 2023 ; Tito et al., 2023 ) .
In 2024–2025, costly exhaustive reading motivated sufficient, high-fidelity evidence acquisition.
Visual page indexing and reading after retrieval in 2024 helped establish explicit retrieval as the main route ( Faysse et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) .
Structural relations, fine-grained selection, and feedback-driven acquisition improved coverage and use of local details in 2025 ( Wang et al., 2026d ; Yun et al., 2025 ) .
In 2026, attention extends to maintaining evidence states, identifying gaps, and coordinating evidence use and verification across rounds under budget constraints ( Zhou et al., 2026a ; Yao et al., 2026b ; Shen et al., 2026c ) .
blocks.zh:
文件VQA的研究已经从内容理解扩大到取证和持续的证据管理(图7)。
2020–2023年,多页表述和跨页聚变扩展了单页理解(田中等,2023;铁托等,2023.
在2024–2025年,昂贵的详尽阅读激发了充分,高真实度的证据采集.
2024年检索后的视觉页面索引和阅读有助于确定明确的检索为主要路线(Faysse等,2025;Yu等,2025)。
2025年,结构关系,精细选取,反馈驱动的收购,提高了本地细节的覆盖范围和使用率(Wang等,2026d; 云等, 2025 (中文(简体) ).
2026年,注意在预算限制下保持证据状态,查明差距,协调各轮证据的使用和核实(周等,2026a; 姚等, 2026b; 沈等, 2026c.).

blocks.en:
Bottlenecks also propagate across components.
Retrieval narrows inputs but risks omissions, motivating structure-aware acquisition and on-demand parsing to preserve evidence relations and details ( Yun et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026f ) .
Feedback makes parsing and retrieval schedulable actions, with generation maintaining evidence states and guiding rereading, acquisition, and stopping ( Wang et al., 2026d ; Yao et al., 2026b ) .
Evaluation must diagnose failures through answers and evidence ( Feng et al., 2026 ) and assess gains against end-to-end cost.
Methods may update selected components while retaining established techniques elsewhere; evolution thus reflects broadening priorities rather than wholesale replacement.
blocks.zh:
Bottlenecks也传播到各个组件之间.
检索缩小了投入,但有遗漏的风险,促使了解结构的获取和按需分析,以维护证据关系和细节(Yun等,2025;Wang等,2026f)。
反馈提供了可解析和检索的可排定时间的行动,一代人维持证据状态并指导重读、获取和停止(Wang等人,2026d; 姚等, 2026b. (简体中文).
评价必须通过答案和证据诊断失败(冯等,2026年)并对照端到端成本评估收益.
方法可以更新某些组成部分,同时保留其他地方的既定技术;因此,演变反映了优先事项的扩大,而不是批发替换。

blocks.en: 4.2 Challenges and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 4.2 挑战与未来方向

blocks.en:
For individual questions, we identify three research directions. Evidence sufficiency. Cross-page context and region extraction improve acquisition ( Tanaka et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026f ) , but local relevance and precise localization do not ensure sufficient support.
Future work should construct question-driven evidence sets and assess their sufficiency. Verifiable and correctable document understanding. Cross-round memory and multilevel evaluation support process verification ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026b ) , but correct answers may mask unreliable intermediate judgments, and early errors can propagate.
Future work should link source tracing, process verification, and error correction. Budget-aware coordination. Action learning and dynamic retrieval improve adaptive acquisition ( Wang et al., 2026d ) , but component gains may not improve the full pipeline.
Future work should coordinate decisions across components using evidence states and budget constraints to balance answer quality and end-to-end cost.
blocks.zh:
对于个别问题,我们确定三个研究方向。 证据充足。 跨页上下文和地区取出改进了收购(Tanaka等,2026;Wang等,2026f),但局部相关性和精确本地化并不能保证足够的支持.
今后的工作应构建由问题驱动的成套证据,并评估其充分性。 可核查和可更正的文件理解。 交叉内存和多层次评价支持过程验证(冯等,2026;姚等,2026b),但正确答案可能掩盖不可靠的中间判断,早期错误可以被传播.
今后的工作应当将源头追踪、过程核查和错误纠正联系起来。 注意预算的协调。 动作学习和动态取回可以改善适应性获取(Wang等,2026d),但组件增益可能无法改善全管.
今后的工作应利用证据状况和预算限制,协调各组成部分的决定,以平衡解决质量和端到端费用。

blocks.en:
Document use often involves follow-up questions and reading across tasks, motivating memory reuse across questions and continual, experience-driven strategy improvement .
The former reuses evidence and interaction states for subsequent questions; the latter turns cross-task experience into transferable retrieval, reading, and verification strategies.
Appendix D details challenges, research opportunities, and task extensions.

文件的使用往往涉及后续问题和跨任务阅读、推动跨问题记忆的再利用以及持续、由经验驱动的战略改进。
前者将证据和互动状态用于以后的问题;后者将跨任务经验转化为可转移检索、阅读和核查战略。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
This survey decomposes long-document VQA into four components and links a fine-grained taxonomy with task bottlenecks, research motivations, and technical evolution.
Emphasizing explicit retrieval while covering direct reading, we trace expanding priorities from multimodal understanding to sufficient, high-fidelity evidence acquisition and sustained management under limited budgets.
Future directions include evidence sufficiency assessment, verifiable and correctable understanding, and budget-aware coordination for individual questions, alongside memory reuse across questions and strategy improvement across tasks toward continual document understanding.
blocks.zh:
本次调查将长文件VQA分解为四个组成部分,并将精细的分解分类法与任务瓶颈,研究动机,技术演化联系起来.
我们强调明确检索,同时包括直接阅读,我们追踪从多式联运理解到在有限预算下充分、高可信度证据的获取和持续管理等日益扩大的优先事项。
今后的方向包括证据充足性评估、可核查和可更正的理解,以及个别问题的预算意识协调,同时对各种问题的内存进行再利用,以及改进各项任务的战略,以持续理解文件。

blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:

Foundational tasks such as text and layout recognition and field and entity extraction are covered only where they affect question answering, without being reviewed in detail.

blocks.en: Appendix A Benchmark Catalog
blocks.zh: 附录A 基准目录

blocks.en:
Beyond the representative comparison in Table 3 , Table 4 catalogs all 55 benchmark records covered in this survey, retaining their scale, question types, and evaluation capabilities.
Benchmarks are grouped by their primary evaluation goal into retrieval-oriented and answer-quality-oriented benchmarks, with the latter further grouped by input page count.
Benchmark selection should distinguish input scale, evidence span, and the stage at which processing begins.
Longer inputs do not necessarily require cross-page evidence combination: MP-DocVQA identifies single-page evidence among multiple candidate pages ( Tito et al., 2023 ) , whereas SlideVQA includes questions requiring evidence across pages ( Tanaka et al., 2023 ) .
An open candidate corpus and a given document reflect different task settings, so page counts alone do not establish relative difficulty.
Benchmarks such as SPIQA provide pre-extracted elements ( Pramanick et al., 2024 ) ; their results primarily measure understanding and evidence selection over the supplied material, rather than full-page parsing.
Evidence annotation granularity further determines what can be verified: document or page retrieval, region localization, and answer quality should be interpreted separately.
blocks.zh:
除了表3中的代表性比较外,表4还列出了本调查涵盖的所有55个基准记录,保留其规模、问题类型和评价能力。
基准按其主要评价目标归类为面向检索和面向答复的质量基准,而后者则按投入页数进一步归类。
基准选择应区分输入尺度、证据跨度和开始处理的阶段。
较长的输入并不一定需要跨页证据组合:MP-DocVQA在多个候选页面中识别出单页证据(Tito等,2023年),而SlidVQA包含需要跨页证据的问题(Tanaka等,2023年).
一个开放式的候选实体和一个特定的文档反映了不同的任务设置,因此单凭页数并不能确定相对的困难.
SPIQA等基准提供了预取要素(Pramanick等,2024年;其结果主要衡量对所提供材料的理解和证据选择,而不是整页分析.
证据注释颗粒性进一步决定了可以核实的内容:文档或页面检索,区域定位,答题质量应分别解释.

blocks.en:
MMLongBench-Doc and M-LongDoc assess long-input processing ( Ma et al., 2024b ; Chia et al., 2025 ) ; SlideVQA and CMDR-Bench probe cross-page evidence requirements ( Tanaka et al., 2023 ; Tanaka et al., 2026 ) ; and MMDocIR and VISA support fine-grained acquisition and source verification ( Dong et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025a ) .
DVisRAG evaluates performance under visual degradation ( Chen et al., 2026a ) , while DocScope analyzes answering bottlenecks under different evidence conditions ( Feng et al., 2026 ) .
Cost comparisons should specify input conditions and budgets and account for parsing, indexing, and online inference, rather than assessing system capabilities through answer scores alone.
blocks.zh:
MMLong Bench-Doc 和 M-Long 组合 Doc评估长期输入处理(Ma等,2024b;Chia等,2025年),SlidVQA和CMDR-Bench探测器的跨页证据要求(Tanaka等,2023年;Tanaka等,2026年),以及MMdocIR和VISA支持精细的获取和来源核实(Dong等,2025年;Ma等,2025年a年)。
DVisRAG在视觉退化下评价性能(Chen等,2026a),而DocScope分析不同证据条件下的解答瓶颈(Feng等,2026).
成本比较应具体说明输入条件和预算,并说明分析、索引编制和在线推论,而不是仅通过回答分数评估系统能力。

blocks.en: Appendix B Methods without Explicit Retrieval
blocks.zh: 附录B 没有明确检索的方法

blocks.en:
Table 5 extends the direct-reading comparison in Table 2 .
These methods organize reading within the supplied content without explicit evidence retrieval in the answering pipeline, and are grouped into single-page and multipage methods according to their primary design and evaluation settings.
Multipage methods make different trade-offs among information organization, input scale, and evidence use.
Hi-VT5 organizes multipage inputs through hierarchical representations ( Tito et al., 2023 ) , GRAM uses document tokens for cross-page communication ( Blau et al., 2024 ) , and mPLUG-DocOwl2 compresses high-resolution visual features to control input scale ( Hu et al., 2025 ) .
M3D and DocR1 strengthen the link between evidence identification and answering through evidence-and-answer supervision and evidence-page rewards, respectively ( Tanaka et al., 2023 ; Xiong et al., 2026b ) .
These designs act on representations, fusion, or learning objectives; Table 5 compares external extraction dependence, generation organization, backbone models, added training, and the dimensions actually evaluated.
blocks.zh:
表5扩展了表2中的直接阅读比较。
这些方法在提供的内容内组织阅读,而不在回答的管道中进行明确的证据检索,并根据其主要设计和评价环境分为一页和多页两种方法。
多页方法在信息组织、投入规模和证据使用之间作出不同的取舍。
Hi-VT5通过分级表示方式组织多页输入(Tito等,2023年),GRAM使用文件符号进行跨页通信(Brau等,2024年),mPLUG-DocOwl2压缩高分辨率视觉功能来控制输入尺度(Hu等,2025年).
M3D和DocR1分别通过证据和回答监督和证据页奖励加强证据识别和回答之间的联系(Tanaka等,2023;Xiong等,2026b.).
表5比较了外部提取依赖性、生成组织、骨干模型、附加培训以及实际评价的维度。

blocks.en:
Direct reading allocates resources among input capacity, detail fidelity, and cross-page relations.
Compression reduces representation size but may lose critical text or visual details.
More input pages broaden coverage and higher resolution improves detail visibility, but both increase reading cost.
Comparisons should therefore consider answer quality, evidence selection, and cost together, distinguishing model capabilities from input configurations.
Direct reading and explicit retrieval are complementary: hierarchical fusion and compression support multipage reading after retrieval, while retrieval further controls the evidence passed to generation.
blocks.zh:
直接读取在输入能力,细节忠诚,和跨页关系之间分配资源.
压缩会缩小表示大小,但可能失去批判文本或视觉细节.
更多的输入页拓宽了覆盖面,更高的分辨率提高了细节能见度,但两者都提高了阅读成本.
因此,比较应考虑答案的质量、证据选择和成本,区分模型能力和输入配置。
直接读取和明示取取是互补的:分级聚和压缩支持取取取后多页取取取,而取取取则进一步控制被取取出出的证据.

D.1 – D.3 , covering evidence sufficiency, verifiable and correctable understanding, and budget-aware coordination toward reliable answers under limited budgets.
blocks.zh: 图8:在长文件VQA中回答个别问题的挑战和未来方向. 三个面板对应Secs. D.1 — D.3, 包括证据的充分性、可核查和可纠正的理解,以及预算意识的协调,以便在有限的预算下找到可靠的答案。

blocks.en: Appendix C Methods with Explicit Retrieval
blocks.zh: 附录C 明确检索的方法

blocks.en:
Table 6 catalogs 110 explicit-retrieval methods, extending the representative comparison in Table 1 .
For retrieval-only methods, the comparison covers evidence representations, matching, and returned results; generation attributes do not apply.
For QA methods, it additionally records how evidence reaches the generator, agent organization, reasoning feedback, and added training.
Parsing, retrieval, generation, and evaluation attributes should be read together: the same visual retriever can support different generation pipelines, and neither structural parsing nor multi-agent organization alone determines whether acquisition is iterative.
blocks.zh:
表6 110明确检索方法,扩大了表1中的代表性比较。
对于只检索的方法,比较范围包括了证据表达,匹配,和返回的结果;生成属性不适用.
就质量保证方法而言,它额外记录了证据如何到达生成者、代理组织、推理反馈和增加培训。
解析,检索,生成,评价等属性应一并读取:同一视觉取取器可以支持不同的生成管道,无论是结构解析还是多代理组织都不能单独决定获取是否是迭代.

blocks.en:
Retriever matching representations should be distinguished from generator inputs. Modality denotes the evidence-side modalities used to assess relevance, whereas Granularity denotes the evidence units actually received by the generator; retrieval-only methods are labeled by their returned units.
When retrieval hits and generation inputs differ in modality or granularity, Mechanism records the mapping with an arrow.
For example, ViDoRAG maps retrieved text chunks to their source page images ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , allowing text matching to support visual page reading. Iterative acquisition introduces evidence beyond the current set in response to generation or control feedback; graph traversal without such feedback, fixed multistage retrieval, and reranking or refinement of existing evidence do not qualify. Reasoning instead describes whether generation involves a feedback loop.
Thus, One-shot acquisition can coexist with Multi-step reasoning, whereas a single CoT or a fixed multi-agent pipeline is classified as Single-pass.
blocks.zh:
应当将匹配的表示与生成器输入区分开来。 模式表示用于评估相关性的证据方模式,而Granularity则表示生成方实际收到的证据单位;仅取回的方法由返回的单位标出.
当检索命中和生成输入在方式或颗粒性上有所不同时,机制会用一箭头记录绘图.
例如,ViDoRAG地图将文本块检索到源页面图像(Wang等人,2025年),允许文本匹配支持可视页面阅读. 迭代获取引入了超出当前集合的证据,以应对生成或控制反馈;没有此类反馈的图向倒转,固定多阶段检索,以及对现有证据的再排位或完善不符合条件. 相反,理性说明生成是否涉及反馈循环。
因此一发收购可以与多步推理并存,而一通COT或一通固定多代理管道则被归类为单通.

blocks.en:
Superscript t t in Mechanism marks added retrieval, scoring, or page-selection training.
Generation-side Learning records added training of answering, control, or tool components; it does not imply that all modules are updated together.
For example, MM-Doc-R1 and DocDancer train only the language agent while freezing the visual Read tool ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026d ) ; AgenticOCR trains only the region tool agent while freezing the final answerer ( Wang et al., 2026f ) ; Doc-REFRAG applies RL only to its token-recovery module ( Hu et al., 2026a ) ; and RobustVisRAG performs feature-alignment training only on the generation-side visual encoder while freezing the language backbone ( Chen et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh:
在机制标记中的上标 t t 添加了检索,打分,或页面选择训练.
世代边 学习记录增加了回答、控制或工具组件的培训;这并不意味着所有模块都一起更新。
例如,MM-Doc-R1和DocDancer在冻结可视读取工具的同时,只培训语言代理(Lin等,2026;Zhang等,2026d;AgenticOCR只培训区域工具代理,而冻结最后的回答器(Wang等,2026f;Doc-REFRAG只将RL应用到其代号回收模块上(Hu等,2026a;和Robust)). VisRAG只在生成侧视觉编码器上进行特征调整培训,同时冻结语言主干(Chen等,2026a) 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: Appendix D Challenges and Research Opportunities
blocks.zh: 附录D 挑战和研究机会

blocks.en:
Building on Sec. 4.2 , this appendix discusses challenges and research opportunities at two levels: improving capabilities within the current task and extending its boundaries.
Secs. D.1 – D.3 examine evidence sufficiency, verifiable and correctable understanding, and budget-aware coordination for individual questions, drawing on existing advances and limitations to identify future directions and concrete research opportunities (Fig. 8 ).
Sec. D.4 extends the independent-question setting through memory reuse across questions and strategy improvement across tasks, broadening the perspective to sustained interaction and accumulated experience.
blocks.zh:
本附录以第4.2条为基础,讨论了两个层面的挑战和研究机会:提高当前任务的能力并扩大其界限。
D.1 -- -- D.3节审查证据的充分性、可核查和可更正的理解以及个别问题的预算意识协调,并借鉴现有进展和限制,以确定未来的方向和具体的研究机会(图8)。
D.4. 将独立问题设定的范围扩大到各种问题的内存再利用和任务的战略改进,将视角扩大到持续的互动和积累的经验。

blocks.en: D.1 Evidence Sufficiency
blocks.zh: D.1 证据的充分性

blocks.en:
Task-oriented evidence sufficiency moves beyond local relevance to the support required for an answer, asking: Is the current evidence sufficient, and what is missing? CMDR-Embed incorporates cross-page context into retrieval representations ( Tanaka et al., 2026 ) , while AgenticOCR narrows page reading to question-relevant regions ( Wang et al., 2026f ) .
Yet contextual association and fine-grained extraction can still omit essential dependencies.
AgenticOCR explicitly notes that extracting only a table row or cell without its header and surrounding context can leave evidence incomplete.
Finding relevant content therefore does not ensure sufficient support for answering.
blocks.zh:
面向任务的证据充足性超越了当地的相关性,转向了回答问题所需的支持,要求: 现有证据是否足够,缺少什么? CMDR-Embed将跨页上下文纳入检索表述(Tanaka等,2026年),而AgenticOCR将页面读取范围缩小到与问题相关的区域(Wang等,2026f.).
然而,背景联系和精细取出仍然可以忽略基本依赖性。
AgenticOCR明确指出,只有取出一个没有标题和周围上下文的表格行或单元格才能留下不完整的证据.
因此,寻找相关内容并不能确保提供足够的答复支持。

blocks.en:
Future direction. Move from matching individual evidence units by relevance to question-driven evidence set construction and sufficiency assessment.
This requires identifying the facts needed for an answer, their dependencies, and the remaining gaps, providing testable grounds for adaptive acquisition and stopping.
blocks.zh:
未来方向. 从按相关性对单个证据单位进行比对转向由问题驱动的证据组构建和充分性评估。
这就需要查明答案所需的事实、其依赖性以及所剩空白,为适应性获取和停止提供可验证的理由。

blocks.en: Research opportunities. (a) Model evidence requirements and dependencies. Organize evidence around the facts, comparisons, and calculation conditions required by the question, distinguishing context used for localization from evidence that directly supports the answer. (b) Select complementary evidence jointly. Treat tables continued across pages, headers and values, or figures and their annotations as interdependent evidence combinations; balance coverage against redundancy and avoid fragmentation that breaks essential semantic dependencies. (c) Learn testable sufficiency judgments. Construct examples with complete evidence, partially missing evidence, and highly relevant but insufficient evidence to test whether models can identify gaps and translate them into explicit acquisition needs.
blocks.zh: 研究机会。 (a) 示范证据要求和依赖性。 围绕问题要求的事实,比较,计算条件组织证据,区分本地化所用的上下文和直接支持答案的证据. (b) 共同选择补充证据。 将各页、标题和数值或数字及其说明继续视为相互依存的证据组合;在覆盖面与冗余之间取得平衡并避免分割,从而打破重要的语义依赖。 (c) 学习可检验的充分性判断。 以完整证据,部分缺失证据,以及高度相关而不充分的证据来构建实例,以测试模型是否能够识别出差距并转化为明确的获取需要.

blocks.en: D.2 Verifiable and Correctable Understanding
blocks.zh: D.2 可核查和可更正的理解

blocks.en:
Verifiable and correctable document understanding moves beyond correct answers to trustworthy evidence chains, asking: Is acquired information used faithfully, and can errors be corrected? Methods such as DocMemo explicitly maintain evidence states across rounds ( Yao et al., 2026b ) , while DocScope verifies pages, regions, facts, and answers ( Feng et al., 2026 ) .
DocScope’s experiments show that correct answers can coexist with incomplete evidence chains.
This raises a further question: can parsing or summarization errors enter memory, affect subsequent acquisition, and become repeatedly reinforced?
blocks.zh:
可核查和可更正的文件理解超越了对可信证据链的正确答案,要求: 获取的信息是否被忠实地使用,错误能否被纠正? DocMemo等方法明确保持了跨回合的证据状态(姚等,2026年b),而DocScope则验证页面,区域,事实和答案(冯等,2026年).
DocScope的实验显示,正确的答案可以与不完整的证据链并存.
这又提出了另一个问题:解析或归纳错误能否输入内存,影响随后的获取,并被反复强化?

blocks.en: Future direction. Connect source tracing, process verification, and error correction to maintain traceable, correctable evidence states across rounds, and evaluate whether systems can detect, locate, and correct errors.
blocks.zh: 未来方向. 连接源追踪,处理校正,并校正出错,以保持可追踪,可更正的证据跨回合状态,并评价系统能否发现,定位,并校正出错.

blocks.en:
Research opportunities. (a) Build revisable evidence memory. Retain source pages, regions, and dependencies for intermediate facts and summaries; when misreadings or conflicts emerge, reread the sources, retract erroneous records, and update dependent judgments. (b) Test whether evidence supports the answer. Remove or replace key evidence under controlled conditions to test whether models detect missing support or changed facts, while checking stability under changes to irrelevant or redundant evidence.
Distinguish citation accuracy, accurate fact reading, and evidential support for the answer. (c) Connect diagnosis to correction. Under cross-page dependencies, distractors, visual degradation, and unanswerable conditions, evaluate whether systems choose to reparse, acquire more evidence, revise the answer, or abstain, and measure their ability to recover from errors.
blocks.zh:
研究机会。 (a) 建立可改写的证据记忆。 保留源的页面,区域和对中间事实和摘要的依赖性;当出现错误读取或冲突时,重新读取源,收回错误的记录,并更新依赖性判断. (b) 检验证据是否支持答复。 在受控条件下去掉或替换关键证据,以测试模型是否检测出缺少支持或改变事实,同时在更改为无关或多余证据的情况下检查稳定性.
区分引用精度,准确的事实读取,对答案的证据支持. (c) 将诊断与矫正联系起来。 在跨页依赖性,分心器,视觉退化等无法解答的条件下,评价系统是否选择重解,获取更多证据,修改答案,或弃权,并衡量其从错误中恢复的能力.

blocks.en: D.3 Decision Making under Budget Constraints
blocks.zh: D.3 根据预算限制作出决定

blocks.en:
Budget-aware coordination moves from local optimization to end-to-end quality–cost trade-offs, asking: Where should limited computation be spent? Visual compression, tool-action learning in VRAG-RL ( Wang et al., 2026d ) , on-demand parsing in AgenticOCR ( Wang et al., 2026f ) , and memory-guided retrieval in DocMemo ( Yao et al., 2026b ) provide several forms of dynamic processing.
However, savings in individual operations may be partly offset by auxiliary model calls, multiple interaction rounds, and state maintenance.
Their quality gains and computational costs must therefore be assessed across the full pipeline.
blocks.zh:
了解预算的协调从地方优化转向端到端的质量-成本权衡,要求: 有限的计算应花在哪里? VRAG-RL(Wang等,2026d.)的视觉压缩,工具动作学习,AgenticOCR的点播解 (Wang et al., 2026f.),多克梅莫(Yao et al., 2026b.)的内存导取回提供了几种活性处理形式.
然而,由于辅助型号调用、多轮互动和状态维护,个别操作节省的费用可能被部分抵销。
因此,必须在整个管道评估其质量收益和计算费用。

blocks.en:
Future direction. Building on dynamic processing and cross-component interactions, use evidence states and remaining budgets to jointly decide whether to search further, inspect local details, reparse, verify a judgment, or finish answering.
Learn evidence acquisition and use jointly under a quality–cost objective.
blocks.zh:
未来方向. 在动态处理和跨部门互动的基础上,利用证据状态和剩余预算共同决定是否进一步搜索、检查当地细节、重新分析、核实判断或完成答复。
在质量-成本目标下共同学习证据获取和使用。

blocks.en:
Research opportunities. (a) Allocate budgets dynamically across components. Adapt parsing scope, visual resolution, retrieval depth, and reasoning rounds to question difficulty and current evidence gaps; determine when direct reading is preferable and when retrieval or tools are worthwhile. (b) Learn the marginal value of actions. Extend action learning by comparing how much an additional retrieval, local rereading, or verification step improves evidence coverage and answer quality, and incorporate cost into action selection and stopping policies. (c) Test generalization across budgets and settings. Compare quality–cost curves across document lengths, degrees of evidence dispersion, and computational budgets.
Include preprocessing, indexing, auxiliary models, and online inference to assess whether policies adapt to practical resource constraints.
blocks.zh:
研究机会。 (a) 在各个构成部分之间动态地分配预算。 调整解析范围,视觉分辨率,检索深度,以及推理回合,以质疑难度和当前证据差距;确定何时直接阅读更可取,何时检索或工具值得. (b) 了解行动的边际价值。 通过比较额外检索、当地重新阅读或核查步骤,扩大行动学习,提高证据覆盖面和答复质量,并将费用纳入行动选择和停止政策。 (c) 测试跨预算和背景的通用性。 比较文件长度、证据分散程度和计算预算的质量-成本曲线。
包括预处理,索引,辅助模型,以及在线推论,以评估政策是否适应实际的资源制约.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Two complementary directions from individual question answering toward continual document understanding. Across questions, systems reuse, supplement, and revise evidence and interaction memory. blocks.en: D.4 Towards Continual Document Understanding
blocks.zh: D.4 不断了解文件

blocks.en:
The preceding three directions focus on answering individual questions.
Building on them, this survey considers how to extend document VQA beyond independent questions.
Practical document use requires systems to solve the current question, exploit connections across successive interactions, and improve subsequent processing strategies through experience across tasks.
We therefore identify two related extensions—memory reuse across questions and continual, experience-driven strategy improvement—that shift the perspective from individual answers to sustained interaction and accumulated capabilities (Fig. 9 ).
blocks.zh:
前三个方向侧重于回答个别问题。
在此基础上,本调查考虑了如何将VQA号文件扩大到独立问题之外。
实际文件使用需要系统解决当前问题,利用接连互动的连接,并通过跨任务的经验来改进后续的处理策略.
因此,我们确定两个相关的扩展——跨问题重复使用记忆和持续、由经验驱动的战略改进——将视角从个别答案转向持续的互动和积累的能力(图9)。

blocks.en:
Memory reuse across questions. Multiturn document VQA over successive user questions must combine document content with interaction history to resolve cross-turn references, carry forward comparison conditions, incorporate user corrections, and reuse evidence that remains applicable.
MemoryDocDataSet explores the combination of conversational memory and reasoning over long text documents ( Xie et al., 2026a ) .
For visual documents, future systems could link dialogue to source pages and regions, retaining provenance, versions, and verified results to reuse earlier localization and reading while acquiring missing support for new questions.
For example, a follow-up about another metric in the same table can reuse the table’s location and measurement conventions.
The key is to assess whether historical information remains applicable and revise affected memories after user corrections or document updates, reducing repeated processing and error propagation.
blocks.zh:
记忆再利用跨问题。 多翻文件VQA相对于接连的用户问题,必须把文件内容与互动历史结合起来,以解决交叉翻转参考,结转比较条件,纳入用户校正,再利用证据仍然适用.
内存DocData 设定在长文本文档(谢等,2026a.)上探索对话记忆和推理的结合.
对于可视化文件,未来的系统可以将对话与源页和区域相链接,保留出处,版本,并核实结果以再用更早的本地化和读取,同时获得新问题的缺失支持.
例如,对同一表格中的另一个计量标准采取后续行动,可以重新利用表格的位置和测量惯例。
关键是评估历史信息是否仍然适用,并在用户更正或文件更新后修改受影响的记忆,减少重复处理和错误传播。

blocks.en:
Continual, experience-driven strategy improvement. Beyond reusing specific evidence, systems could accumulate transferable processing strategies from experience across tasks.
Because document types differ in structure and evidence dependencies, systems need to learn which retrieval, reading, and verification procedures suit which conditions.
MemSkill revises memory skills through difficult cases ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , while AIDE 2 enables updated agents to continue participating in their own improvement ( Srikanth et al., 2026 ) , offering insights from general-purpose agents.
Inspired by recursive self-improvement (RSI), future systems could propose strategies from document-QA successes, failures, and user feedback, validate them on independent tasks before updating a skill library or control procedure, and let the updated system participate in subsequent strategy revision.
For example, experience with financial reports could yield a procedure that checks units and reporting periods before comparing values.
The central challenge is to establish applicability conditions and feedback grounds that support strategy transfer to subsequent documents.
blocks.zh:
不断以经验为驱动的战略改进. 除了重新使用具体证据外,系统还可以从跨任务的经验中积累可转移的处理战略。
由于文件类型在结构和证据依赖性上有所不同,系统需要了解哪些检索、阅读和核查程序符合哪些条件。
MemSkill通过困难案例修改记忆技能(张等,2026b.),而AIDE 2则使更新的代理能够继续参与自己的改进(Srikanth等,2026.),提供通用代理的洞察力.
在递归自我改进(RSI)的启发下,未来的系统可以从文档-QA的成功,失败和用户反馈中提出策略,在更新技能库或控制程序之前验证它们的独立任务,并让更新后的系统参与随后的战略修订.
例如,财务报告的经验可以产生一种程序,在比较价值之前先检查单位和报告期。
主要的挑战是建立适用条件和反馈理由,以支持战略向后续文件的转移。

blocks.en: Header abbreviations. Deep = Deep Parsing; Gran. = Granularity; Acq. = Acquisition; Eval. = Evaluation. Type labels. Deep and Learning list structure and training types directly; a standalone ✓ in Learning denotes added training without a listed type. SFT/RL: supervised fine-tuning/reinforcement learning. 1. Mechanism. D/P/E denotes document/page/element; superscripts T/V/TV denote text/visual/both. The left side of → \rightarrow is the evidence representation returned by retrieval or selection; the right side is the generation input. Without an arrow, retrieval and generation use the same granularity and modality; retrieval-only methods are labeled by their returned unit. Superscript t denotes additional retrieval, scoring, or page-selection training. Parentheses after model names specify evidence forms; semicolons separate independent paths, and an arrow applies only within its path. Brackets [ ] group multiple evidence items, with commas denoting parallel items. 2. Evaluation. Only dimensions quantitatively reported in the original paper are listed. Ret. evaluates evidence retrieval, usually page-level hits, recall, or ranking; Loc. evaluates within-page element/region localization or coverage, such as IoU or region-overlap recall. Exceptions (a): Ret. is document retrieval for DocMMIR, DocPC, NeuSym-RAG, and Agentic Hybrid (EXTRACTOR), document identification for HiKEY, and additionally document recall for HEAVEN; LILaC evaluates layout-element retrieval, and Doc-Researcher evaluates document/page/layout-element retrieval. G 2 -Reader Ret. measures semantic coverage of evidence statements; LFRAG includes element-ID matching; HierDoc includes region-ID-set F1; MoDora evaluates evidence-node recall and filtering. ReAlign Loc. measures overlap between attention regions and supervised boxes; RGenCite includes VLM-assessed evidence support; Lang2Act measures the proportion of internal attention falling within gold regions. MMRetHeads evaluates pages and layout regions on MMDocIR; LMS-Retrieval Ret./Loc. measure layout-element recall and region coverage.
